result.rationale: Verified: addGuests.schema.ts uses z.array(z.string().email()) with no uniqueness refinement, while AddGuestsDialog.tsx adds a .refine for uniqueness client-side only. The handler's uniqueGuests filter only checks guests against booking.attendees and the blacklist, not against each other, so duplicates within the input pass through to createMany, creating duplicate Attendee rows and duplicate emails. Server-side validation gap reachable via direct tRPC mutation is a real defect.

judged_text: The server schema accepts duplicate emails (z.array(z.string().email()) with no uniqueness refinement) while the dialog's hand-copied schema (AddGuestsDialog.tsx:26-29) enforces uniqueness only client-side, and the handler's filter dedupes only against existing attendees, never within the input array. A direct API call with ['a@b.com','a@b.com'] creates two Attendee rows for the same address and sends that person two 'booking confirmed' emails with a duplicated calendar attendee list; the client and server schemas are parallel hand-maintained copies that have already drifted.

adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: server input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` (packages/trpc/.../addGuests.schema.ts) is `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness check, while the client dialog defines its own Zod schema with a `refine` enforcing uniqueness (apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx). In the handler, `uniqueGuests` filters only against existing `booking.attendees` and blacklist (addGuests.handler.ts) and does not dedupe within the incoming `guests` array, so `['a@b.com','a@b.com']` will produce duplicate `guestsFullDetails` and be passed to `attendees.createMany`. The email sending also uses `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` (original, not deduped), and since `evt.attendees` comes from the updated attendee list, duplicated attendee rows can lead to multiple emails being sent to the same address. This is a correctness/data-integrity defect exposed by the diff, and the duplicated parallel schemas have already drifted.
